description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayDiscovery UI components in a Swift project. It defines test cases for verifying the UI rendering of discovery lists with different gateway configurations, using the XCTest framework with custom test annotations.

classes.name: MasterDiscoveryMenuSmokeTests
classes.description: A test suite for testing the master discovery menu UI components, such as inline lists and menus with gateway data.

methods.name: `inline list builds body when empty`
methods.description: Tests that the inline list UI builds correctly when there are no gateways to display.

methods.name: `inline list builds body with master and selection`
methods.description: Tests the inline list UI when gateways are discovered and includes a selected target.

methods.name: `menu builds body with masters`
methods.description: Tests that the menu UI correctly displays multiple gateway options.
